summary: NervGen Pharma Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, disclosing positive results from independent, blinded biomechanical gait analyses of its Phase 1b/2a CONNECT SCI study for NVG-291 in chronic tetraplegia. The filing reports a statistically significant multivariate Global Treatment Effect (GTE = +0.45; p=0.0197) and a responder rate of 100% for NVG-291 versus 10% for placebo (p=0.0001). This is a routine press release of clinical trial data, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms, strategic review, or structural change is involved.
